title: Linux (Ubuntu 24.04) merge-queue run failed on attempt 1, no failure logs available on attempt 2
signature: no failure logs available run already on attempt 2|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Unknown (logs unavailable)
failed_jobs.symptom: Attempt 1 failed; attempt 2 is in progress with all visible jobs passing. Original failure logs were not captured before re-run.

root_cause: The workflow run was reported as failed (attempt 1) but by the time CI Doctor investigated, the run was already on attempt 2 with no failed jobs. The pre-downloaded failure logs and job metadata are empty, indicating the failure logs from attempt 1 were unavailable. This pattern is consistent with a transient infrastructure issue (e.g., runner startup failure, resource exhaustion, or network timeout) that resolved on re-run.
recommended_actions: Monitor attempt 2 result - if it passes, the failure was transient.
If attempt 2 also fails, re-investigate with fresh logs from that attempt.
prevention_strategies: No specific prevention possible without root cause. GitHub Actions runner transient failures are expected occasionally.
historical_context: This is a known pattern where CI Doctor is triggered by attempt 1 failure but logs are unavailable by investigation time.
